package main

import \(
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss"
\)

func main\(\) {
	a := "tabline\\ndivider"
	b := "line1\\nline2\\nline3\\nstatus"
	joined := lipgloss.JoinVertical\(lipgloss.Left, a, b\)
	lines := strings.Split\(joined, "\\n"\)
	fmt.Printf\("a lines: %d\\n", strings.Count\(a, "\\n"\)+1\)
	fmt.Printf\("b lines: %d\\n", strings.Count\(b, "\\n"\)+1\)
	fmt.Printf\("joined lines: %d\\n", len\(lines\)\)
	for i, l := range lines {
		fmt.Printf\("  %d: %q\\n", i, l\)
	}
}
EOF)
